info.description: A class pass product — number of sessions, validity period, and price.

content-manager.label: Pricing Tier
content-manager.description: The membership tier this pass belongs to.

content-manager.label: Duration Label
content-manager.description: Human-readable duration shown to customers, e.g. "1 Month" or "3 Months".

content-manager.label: Duration in Days
content-manager.description: Exact number of days — used to calculate pass expiry.

content-manager.label: Price (LKR)
content-manager.description: Price in Sri Lankan Rupees. Do not include commas or currency symbols.

content-manager.label: PayHere Item Name
content-manager.description: Short item name sent to the PayHere payment gateway. No special characters.

content-manager.label: Available for Purchase?
content-manager.description: If unticked, this pass is hidden from the pricing page.

content-manager.label: Sort Order
content-manager.description: Lower numbers appear first in listings. Items with the same number are sorted alphabetically.
